name: ClickUp
tagline: All-in-one project management with docs, goals, and time tracking
painPoints: Feature overload makes onboarding difficult and overwhelming
Performance is sluggish, especially with large workspaces
AI features are bolt-ons rather than core to the workflow
Frequent bugs and UI inconsistencies frustrate daily users
Mobile app lags significantly behind the desktop experience
metaDescription: Looking for a ClickUp alternative? GAIA is source-available AI that triages email, manages tasks, and runs workflows across 50+ tools. Free tier included.
whyPeopleLook: ClickUp's promise of being the 'one app to replace them all' has attracted millions of users, but the reality often falls short. The sheer number of features — views, docs, goals, time tracking, whiteboards, sprints — creates a steep learning curve that derails adoption. Users frequently report that they spend more time configuring ClickUp than completing tasks. The AI layer added in ClickUp AI 2.0 helps with text generation but does not fundamentally change the manual nature of project management. People searching for ClickUp alternatives usually want something that reduces cognitive overhead rather than adding to it.
gaiaReplaces: Personal task management without view configuration overhead
Automated task creation from email and calendar inputs
Goal tracking through natural language check-ins with GAIA
Time-awareness via calendar integration that surfaces scheduling conflicts
gaiaAdvantages: Zero configuration: GAIA works out of the box with your existing tools
Proactive intelligence instead of passive task storage
Faster on all devices including mobile, web, desktop, and CLI
Source-available codebase; audit and extend GAIA's capabilities yourself
Single flat pricing instead of per-feature or per-seat tiers
migrationSteps: Export your ClickUp tasks and lists via the built-in export feature
Import tasks into GAIA's task engine or connected Todoist
Set GAIA to monitor Gmail for new action items to replace manual task entry
Recreate key automations using GAIA's workflow builder

faqs.question: Does GAIA have multiple views like ClickUp (list, board, calendar)?
faqs.answer: GAIA focuses on conversational task management rather than providing multiple visual views. It surfaces tasks proactively and lets you manage them via natural language rather than switching between list, board, and Gantt views.

faqs.question: Is GAIA less complex than ClickUp?
faqs.answer: Significantly so. GAIA has no views to configure, no permission hierarchies to manage, and no feature menus to navigate. You interact with your tasks, email, and calendar through conversation.

faqs.question: Can GAIA replace ClickUp's time tracking?
faqs.answer: GAIA does not include a dedicated time tracker. However, it can integrate with time tracking tools via MCP and can report on how your calendar time is allocated.

faqs.question: How does GAIA compare to ClickUp for team use?
faqs.answer: ClickUp is better suited for teams that need shared project boards and task assignment. GAIA is optimized for individual AI assistance — it is the ideal co-pilot for each person on a team using their own tools.
